versions.title_at_revision: Verify that the fuel system is safely compatible with other system interfaces.
Verify that the fuel system is safely compatible with other system interfaces.

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the fuel system is safely compatible with other system interfaces. Standard: The fuel system design requirements, including interfaces, are functionally and physically compatible with other air vehicle systems (e.g., propulsion, hydraulic, electrical, pneumatic, inerting, display, aerial refueling and other unique interfaces) and other ground support equipment (e.g., fuel trucks, hydrant delivery systems, closed circuit refueling). Method of Compliance: Interface requirements are documented and verified through design analysis and modeling, component qualification tests, system functional checkout tests, and ground/flight tests. References: JSSG-2009: 3.4.4.1, 4.4.4.1; E.3.4.5.1.1, E.4.4.5.1.1; E.3.4.5.1.2, E.4.4.5.1.2; E.3.4.5.1.3, E.4.4.5.1.3; E.3.4.5.1.3.11, E.4.4.5.1.3.11; E.3.4.5.2.1, E.4.4.5.2.1; E.3.4.5.2.2, E.4.4.5.2.2; E.3.4.5.3, E.4.4.5.3 14 CFR 23.951-23.979, 23.991-23.1001, 25.951-25.981, 25.991-25.1001, 27.951- 27.977, 27.991-27.999, 29.951-29.979, 29.992-29.1001

Standard: The fuel system is functionally and physically compatible with other air vehicle systems (e.g., propulsion, hydraulic, electrical, pneumatic, inerting, display, AR and other unique interfaces) and other ground support equipment (e.g., fuel trucks, hydrant delivery systems, closed circuit refueling). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review design documentation (e.g., ICDs) to verify interface requirements of the fuel system are established between air vehicle systems. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis of interface requirements between the fuel system and other systems to verify functional and physical compatibility. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct component and fuel system integration testing to verify the functional and physical compatibility of the fuel system with other air vehicle systems.
    (2) Ground test: Conduct fuel system function checkout tests to verify physical and functional compatibility between the fuel system and other systems. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (3) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to show compatibility between the fuel system and other systems while in flight.
